question: What annual instalment will discharge a debt of ₹26,160 due in 4 years at 6% simple interest p.a.?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the annual instalment be 100 units.

Total debt at the end of 4 years = 100 + 106 + 112 + 118 = 436 units.

Given 436 units = ₹26,160 ⇒ 1 unit = 26160 ÷ 436 = 60.

Annual Instalment = 100 units = 100 × 60 = ₹6,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6,000.**
